audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 with 48.76% WR is defensible: Swain wins the lane on every chart row, and the sub-50 WR comes from Ekko's roam/map pressure, which the content mid/late text already calls out explicitly.
Chart is all-Swain on full, content and packet — full agreement, no edits. Spikes correctly key Swain's windows to rooting his commit and draining under the Chronobreak heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits, and the Phase Dive auto-reset wind-up tell (missingInteractions autoreset-burst-tell) was nowhere on the page; the W-shield and untargetable-R interactions were already covered in spikes.
audit.why: Kit: Chronobreak 110/80/50s and heals a percentage of recent damage (anti-heal relevant); Parallel Convergence 22s rank 1, stuns only if he enters the anomaly; Phase Dive is a 325-range roll whose empowered attack teleports him — the wind-up is the visible tell.
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers written in; Phase Dive tell now carried by dontsFull[2].d; W window carried by breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to match their titles (W roam-vision; don't chase the reset assassin).

edits.before: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Nevermove has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — 110s at rank 1, 50s at rank 3. It erases your kill and bursts back: track the hologram and save final damage for after it. - Parallel Convergence is 22s at rank 1 — once the stun zone is spent, his all-in has no lockup.

edits.before: E his step-up, passive-pull the root for the chunk + heal, Q the retreat — every landed root is a won trade with a health refund attached.
edits.after: His roams start when his wave crashes — Vision of Empire covers the river path, and its reveal plus slow gives your side lanes the seconds they need.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 like the demon is already online — Swain without R is a slow mage with a dream and a root on cooldown.
edits.after: His Phase Dive wind-up is the tell to step back — chase into it and he stuns you in W, then Chronobreak heals everything back.

notes: Level chart already agreed everywhere (all Swain) — no chart edits. Missing interactions: untargetable-R and W-shield were already stated in content spikes; the Phase Dive auto-reset tell is now on the page via dontsFull[2].d. The anti-heal-vs-Chronobreak timing (Grievous before his rewind) could not be added without exceeding the report cap or inventing a new field — report[8].t (Itemization) was not lint-flagged, so it was left alone; flagging here so QA can decide. Chronobreak heals off damage received, so a pre-R Grievous buy is genuinely relevant.
